hero.definition: All-on-X replaces a whole arch of missing or failing teeth with a fixed bridge supported by 4 to 6 dental implants. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami the package is $10,000 per arch ($9,000 cash) for up to 6 implants and a hybrid bridge; extractions, grafts and sinus lifts are quoted separately after a CT scan.
hero.lead: For a whole jaw of missing or failing teeth. Implants placed and a fixed temporary bridge fitted in one visit, final zirconia teeth after healing. Nothing removable.

image.alt: Man in his sixties laughing with a fixed All-on-X arch
image.caption: All-on-X fixed arch · From $10,000 per arch · 5-year written warranty

candidates.title: For a whole jaw, not a few teeth
candidates.intro: If any of these is you, All-on-X is the right conversation to have.

items.d: Most of the arch is beyond saving with crowns or root canals.
Fixed teeth never come out, never slip and need no adhesive.
Angled implants use the bone you have, often without grafting.
Steak, apples and nuts again, with teeth that stay put.
Fixed teeth support your lips and cheeks from the inside.

why.title: Surgery, lab and final teeth under one roof.
why.body: Your surgeon, restorative doctor and ceramist work in the same building. That is why your temporary bridge is fitted the same day as surgery and your final teeth are shaped and shaded in person.

week.title: Your All-on-X timeline
week.intro: One visit for surgery and same-day teeth, healing at home, then one week in Miami for your final bridge.

visits.d: Send photos and any X-rays. A doctor replies with your treatment plan within 6 hours and tells you if a CT scan is needed first.
Extractions if needed, 4 to 6 implants placed, and a fixed temporary bridge screwed in the same day. Local anesthesia.
visits.time: One day. Soft diet for 2 weeks.

visits.d: Implants fuse with bone while you wear fixed temporary teeth. Check-ins by video.
Scans, try-in and delivery of your final fixed teeth across one week in Miami.

price.title: $10,000 per arch. $9,000 cash.
price.body: $10,000 per arch, or $9,000 cash, for up to 6 implants and a hybrid fixed bridge. Extractions, bone graft, sinus lift and membranes are quoted separately from the price list if your CT shows they are needed.

faq.title: All-on-X questions, answered by the doctors

items.a: Four implants is the standard protocol. Six adds support for a heavy bite or softer bone. Your CT scan decides, not the price.
No. A fixed temporary bridge is fitted the same day as surgery. You leave with teeth.
Usually not. The back implants are angled to use the bone you have. If grafting is needed, it is in your written estimate.
Long-term studies report 94 to 98 percent of implants and about 99 percent of bridges still in function at 10 years. Zirconia bridges typically last 10 to 20 years.
Under local anesthesia. Most patients describe pressure rather than pain and go home the same afternoon.
